style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a brushed steel surface, split-screen diptych with left-right scenario contrast. Left side: a sprawling, multi-tiered vertical rack of identical interlocking bays and latched inspection covers, representing a six-rung ladder. Right side: a single, dense, sleek graphics processing block with heavy metallic heatsinks and gold connectors. Hard clean edges, one directional light throwing long cast shadows, matte muted palette of industrial grey and anodized black, generous negative space, no text.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, numbers, UI, watermarks, blurry, soft, organic shapes, text, lettering, logos
rationale: The story hinges on structural multiplication vs consolidated local hardware; a minimalist component assembly perfectly constructs this mathematical duality without relying on literal datacenters.
subject: a sprawling multi-tiered server rack contrasted with a single dense graphics processing block
core_thesis: Cloud transcoding bills per output minute scaled by a massive multiplier table, making a local encode box drastically cheaper over time.
core_conflict: Escalating cloud render ladder multipliers versus fixed capital hardware efficiency.
